isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged São Tomé and Príncipe lexicon here. Forro, Angolar, and Lung’Ie are separate datasets under this folder. Do not copy between them. Do not insert Cabo Verdean or Guinea-Bissau vocabulary.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query data/saotome/forro/, data/saotome/angolar/, or data/saotome/lungie/. A merged STP lexicon is not stored at this path.
